about.en: A Meme Coin (MEME) is a community memecoin on Robinhood Chain, an ERC-20 at 0x385F4f8ae47651ce5F58F5265395a669f8281e18 with a 1,000,000,000 supply, whose main pool pairs it with Robinhood's tokenized AMC stock token. Some venues list it as MEMECOIN. It has no stated utility, does not represent AMC equity, and is unrelated to Memeland's MEME on Ethereum.
